subject: Promo allocation request — OrbitLab (Velocity cohort)
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@orbitlab.ai>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Cc: accelerator@velocityvc.org
Date: 2026-11-27T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request: promotional allocation for Velocity cohort

Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking the time at Velocity last week — OrbitLab was excited to get positive feedback from your runtime team. The program manager at Velocity asked me to reach out to see if Redwood can provide a promotional allocation for the cohort kickoff (we're cohort K23).

Quick background: OrbitLab is a seed-stage dev tools startup (12 people) building a vector search assistant that will ingest customer docs. We're expecting 3–5 pilot customers in Q1 and would use Redwood for both embeddings and real-time generation. We estimate ~200–400k tokens/month initially, ramping if pilots go well.

What we need from Redwood:
- A short-term promotional allocation (3 months) to cover early pilot usage
- Visibility into quotas and a simple path to extend if usage and billing look good
- Any security/compliance checkpoints that might block early onboarding (SOC2 evidence, IP handling notes)

I've attached the cohort deck and a short product one-pager. Can you point me to the eligibility checklist and next steps? Velocity prefers that offers to their founders be approved by your partnerships/sales lead.

Appreciate any guidance — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Lina Park
Co-founder, OrbitLab
lina@orbitlab.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments:
- orbitlab-deck.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
- orbitlab-onepager.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@orbitlab.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: promotional allocation for Velocity cohort

Thanks Lina — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated.

High level on our startup path: Redwood offers time-limited promotional allocations for accelerator cohorts. Approval typically depends on a few simple criteria: product fit (embeddings + generation use case fits our hosting models), expected consumption profile, and a light security checklist for pilot data. For cohort participants we usually do a 3-month allocation with a milestone-driven extension option.

Can you confirm the following so we can route this to partnerships for approval?
1) Estimated monthly token usage for month 1/2/3 (rough numbers are fine)
2) Primary data class (customer PII? internal docs? public datasets?)
3) Whether you need Private/VPC deployment for the pilots or if hosted API is sufficient
4) Billing owner (company name + email) and whether Velocity will take any responsibility for program administration

Next steps I can do from here: share our mutual action plan (MAP) template and a short promo terms summary for Velocity cohorts. Marissa — looping you in; she manages promotional approvals and partnerships. Ben — adding you for any technical onboarding questions (SSO, SOC2 artifact path).

If it's helpful, here's an example allocation structure we typically propose for similar cohorts:
- Initial: 50k token allocation (embeddings + generation combined) applied to account over 3 months
- Extension trigger: if 70% of allocation is used in month 2 and onboarding metrics look healthy (1+ pilot customer onboarded), we'll consider a second tranche up to 150k tokens and a 30-day billing transition buffer

I'll attach the MAP template and the brief terms document. Please reply with the items above and any constraints from Velocity.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Developer Partnerships
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

Attachments:
- map_template.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)
- cohort_promo_summary.txt (text, 3KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@orbitlab.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T14:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: promotional allocation for Velocity cohort

Hi Lina — welcome, and thanks, Alex, for the context.

Velocity cohorts are a strong source of early customers; we can approve a conditional promotional allocation for OrbitLab. Outline below and items we need to finalize: 

Approved (conditional):
- Allocation: 50,000 tokens (embeddings + generation combined) applied to OrbitLab account over 90 days starting on activation date.
- Extension: up to an additional 150,000 tokens by request if month-2 usage reaches >= 70% of the initial allocation and basic onboarding milestones complete (pilot joined, SSO configured or API keys rotated).
- Billing: OrbitLab to provide billing contact and PO if required before extension.

Conditions / required artifacts before activation:
1) OrbitLab to complete short security checklist (SOC2 summary acceptable; link below).
2) Signed MAP (mutual action plan) with milestones — I'll send via DocuSign.
3) HubSpot deal record confirmation (we use this for partner reporting) — see link below.

Please review and confirm acceptance of these points by replying to this thread. Once we have the signed MAP and completed checklist, Alex/Ben can trigger the allocation and share onboarding docs.

Lina — I'll send the DocuSign for the MAP and the promo terms PDF; sign and return and we'll get you live. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/16237 (you can reference RDW-16237).

Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments sent: promo_terms.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/promo/16237
